explanation: Merged main (#30, #31) into the query-wire branch. From this branch: queryWire.test.ts pins the published query-index names and row layouts, round-trips every row codec, checks trackEntry against the qcFlags low-power rule and proves the client reads where the generator writes; resultBars.test.tsx drops its client-only cardGlobalName pin. From main: From this branch: sourceJson.test.ts covers the transport's family allow-list, version cache-bust, shared requests, forget-on-failure and reset; baselineTeaser.test.ts checks over the real reader that every teaser row equals the survey's group mean and that AgRP groups are not pooled; survey loader tests use resetSourceRequests/sourceJson and portal/gene-report fixtures use the groups shape. From main: explorerSession.test.tsx pins the analysis snapshot against the session's defaults.
